messages:
maria: PR #42891 is blocked — integration shard12 is intermittently failing `session-store-ttl-spec` on Windows 2022. Fails ~30s into the test. Need eyes and a targeted rerun or advice on whether to update a snapshot.
ci-bot: build 42891.1 failed on integ-shard12 (win-2022). Failure: AssertionError in session TTL eviction after 30.2s. Logs: https://ci.internal/redwood/42891/1/logs
alex: on it. Can you paste the stacktrace and the exact test command you used? Any timer/tick changes in this PR?
maria: test command: `./scripts/test --shard=12 --filter=session-store-ttl-spec`
stacktrace:
```
Error: expected 0 keys but found 1
 at Timeout._onTimeout (test/session-ttl.test.js:214:15)
 at listOnTimeout (internal/timers.js:549:17)
 at processTimers (internal/timers.js:492:7)
```
sam: that looks like a race where eviction runs slightly later on windows images. It passed on linux and mac in CI. My hunch: clock skew + timer resolution. Recommend a targeted rerun on shard12 to confirm flake.
lucy: I can queue a targeted rerun but we only have 2 spare windows slots right now. Need an explicit +1 to use one.
pat: +1 to rerun — looks flaky and we should confirm before pushing a snapshot change. :thumbsup:
lucy: queued targeted rerun as build 42891.2 on integ-shard12 (win-2022). Will update when it finishes.
ci-bot: build 42891.2 started on integ-shard12 (agent: win-runner-9)
ci-bot: build 42891.2 finished — shard12: PASSED. Marking 42891 as flaky on that shard.
alex: ok that confirms flake. No snapshot update needed. Suggest adding a tiny stabilization: wrap the eviction check in a retry loop with small backoff in the test, or loosen timing assertion by 50ms.
maria: thanks — I'll open a follow-up PR with a retry helper and link it here. For now I'll remove the merge hold. Will wait 10m in case another shard flake shows up.
sam: if it flakes again, we should bisect by reverting the timer-related commits in this PR then reapply.
lucy: noted. closing targeted rerun ticket. Thanks everyone. :wave:
